checksum_reference: SHA-256 of official Savannah release archive, downloaded 2026-10-26
changes: Replace bundled FreeType with official 2.15.0 release source; previous 2.14.3 source matched official archive byte-for-byte
Compile and link native sources from this project
Do not enable or build optional PNG decoding; outlines only
Use DEP_Z_INCLUDE if needed by the native build
Preserve upstream FFI API while suppressing function-pointer equality derive warnings; Fonts never compares callbacks

Define FT_CONFIG_OPTION_SYSTEM_ZLIB and select libz-sys static feature; gzip uses bundled zlib 1.4 rather than FreeType private zlib 1.3.1. LIBZ_SYS_STATIC=0 is an explicit build-environment override.
Compile hvf/hvf module stub required by the 2.15.0 default module list; experimental HVF option remains disabled.
Restore original MVAR target metrics when the current delta is zero; moving axes back to a zero-delta location no longer leaves stale OS/2 values in FreeType.
Track the bundled freetype2 source directory in Cargo so native source modifications trigger a rebuild.

unused_libpng.changes: Update unmodified upstream C/H sources from 1.6.44; retain vendor-only generated pnglibconf.h and keep decoder disabled.
